description: Land Title Settlement Department - Wathuragama, Dompe D/S Division, Gampaha District - Cad. Map No. 511002 and other Title Settlements
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act. It contains detailed declarations of land title determinations for specific parcels of land, including parcel numbers, ownership details, extent of land, and other land-related particulars. The content appears in "PART III - LANDS" of the gazette and focuses entirely on land registration and property ownership matters, fitting perfectly within the Land Gazettes category.
